arxiv-1909-12212.creator: Simone Ragoni for the ALICE Collaboration
arxiv-1909-12212.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Simone Ragoni for the ALICE Collaboration. The LHC is not only the highest energy collider for protons and heavy ions, but also for photon–photon and photon–hadron ( γ \gamma p and γ \gamma Pb) interactions. This is because the protons and ions accelerated in the LHC carry an electromagnetic field, which can be viewed as a source of photons, and such photons can interact with either other photons or with hadrons.

arxiv-2105-09064.title: Efficient approximation of high-dimensional exponentials by tensor networks
arxiv-2105-09064.creator: Martin Eigel, Nando Farchmin, Sebastian Heidenreich
arxiv-2105-09064.description: Abstract In this work a general approach to compute a compressed representation of the exponential exp ⁡ ( h ) \exp(h) of a high-dimensional function h h is presented. Such exponential functions play an important role in several problems in Uncertainty Quantification, e.g. the approximation of log-normal random fields or the evaluation of Bayesian posterior measures.

arxiv-2211-09110.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
arxiv-2211-09110.creator: Percy Liang, Rishi Bommasani, Tony Lee, Dimitris Tsipras, Dilara Soylu, Michihiro Yasunaga, Yian Zhang, Deepak Narayanan, Yuhuai Wu, Ananya Kumar, Benjamin Newman, Binhang Yuan, Bobby Yan, Ce Zhang, Christian Cosgrove, Christopher D. Manning, Christopher Ré, Diana Acosta-Navas, Drew A. Hudson, Eric
arxiv-2211-09110.description: Abstract Language models (LMs) are becoming the foundation for almost all major language technologies, but their capabilities, limitations, and risks are not well understood. arxiv-2404-03127.title: A Bayesian factor analysis model for high-dimensional microbiome count data
arxiv-2404-03127.creator: Ismaïla Ba, Maxime Turgeon, Simona Veniamin, Juan Jovel, Richard Miller, Morag Graham, Christine Bonner, Charles N. Bernstein, Douglas L. Arnold, Amit Bar-Or, Ruth Ann Marrie, Julia O’Mahony, E. Ann Yeh, Brenda Banwell, Emmanuelle Waubant, Natalie Knox, Gary Van Domselaar, Ali I. Mirza, Heather Arms
arxiv-2404-03127.description: Abstract Dimension reduction techniques are among the most essential analytical tools in the analysis of high-dimensional data. Generalized principal component analysis (PCA) is an extension to standard PCA that has been widely used to identify low-dimensional features in high-dimensional discrete data, such as binary, multi-category and count data.

arxiv-2411-15535.title: Teaching Shortest Path Algorithms With a Robot and Overlaid Projections
arxiv-2411-15535.creator: Pavel Jolakoski, Jordan Aiko Deja, Klen Čopič Pucihar, Matjaž Kljun
arxiv-2411-15535.description: Abstract Robots have the potential to enhance teaching of advanced computer science topics, making abstract concepts more tangible and interactive. In this paper, we present Timmy –a GoPiGo robot augmented with projections to demonstrate shortest path algorithms in an interactive learning environment.

arxiv-2502-11857.title: A Proposed End-To-End Principle for Data Commons
arxiv-2502-11857.creator: Robert L Grossman
arxiv-2502-11857.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Robert L Grossman. A data commons brings together (or co-locates) data with cloud computing infrastructure and commonly used software services, tools and applications for managing, analyzing and sharing data to create an interoperable resource for a research community. We introduce an architectural design principle for data commons called the narrow middle architecture that is broadly based upon the end-to-end argument in systems design. We also discuss important core services for data commons and the role of standards.

arxiv-2504-14683.title: Polynomial-Time Constant-Approximation for Fair Sum-of-Radii Clustering
arxiv-2504-14683.creator: Sina Bagheri Nezhad Sayan Bandyapadhyay Tianzhi Chen
arxiv-2504-14683.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sina Bagheri Nezhad Sayan Bandyapadhyay Tianzhi Chen. In a seminal work, Chierichetti et al. [ 22 ] introduced the ( t , k ) (t,k) -fair clustering problem: Given a set of red points and a set of blue points in a metric space, a clustering is called fair if the number of red points in each cluster is at most t t times and at least 1 / t 1/t times the number of blue points in that cluster.

arxiv-2508-06253.title: Low dimensional dynamics of a sparse balanced synaptic network of quadratic integrate-and-fire neurons
arxiv-2508-06253.creator: Maria V. Ageeva, Denis S. Goldobin
arxiv-2508-06253.description: Abstract Kinetics of a balanced network of neurons with a sparse grid of synaptic links is well representable by the stochastic dynamics of a generic neuron subject to an effective shot noise. The rate of delta-pulses of the noise is determined self-consistently from the probability density of the neuron states.

arxiv-2601-20318.title: CPiRi: Channel Permutation-Invariant Relational Interaction for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2601-20318.creator: Jiyuan Xu, Wenyu Zhang, Xin Jing, Shuai Chen, Shuai Zhang, Jiahao Nie
arxiv-2601-20318.description: Abstract Current methods for multivariate time series forecasting can be classified into channel-dependent and channel-independent models. Channel-dependent models learn cross-channel features but often overfit the channel ordering, which hampers adaptation when channels are added or reordered. Channel-independent models treat each channel in isolation to increase flexibility, yet this neglects inter-channel dependencies and limits performance.

pmc-10617061.title: Preadipocytes in human granulation tissue: role in wound healing and response to macrophage polarization
pmc-10617061.creator: Tina Rauchenwald, Florian Handle, Catherine E. Connolly, Antonia Degen, Christof Seifarth, Martin Hermann, Christoph H. Tripp, Doris Wilflingseder, Susanne Lobenwein, Dragana Savic, Leo Pölzl, Evi M. Morandi, Dolores Wolfram, Ira-Ida Skvortsova, Patrizia Stoitzner, Johannes Haybaeck, Marko Konschake
pmc-10617061.description: BackgroundChronic non-healing wounds pose a global health challenge. Under optimized conditions, skin wounds heal by the formation of scar tissue. However, deregulated cell activation leads to persistent inflammation and the formation of granulation tissue, a type of premature scar tissue without epithelialization.

pmc-11402921.title: Increasing the productivity and quality of cucumber crop by improving the performance of the evaporative cooling system
pmc-11402921.creator: Mohamed A Rashwan, Ibrahim M Al-Helal, Sulaiman S Al-Showaiman, Adil A Fickak, Waleed A Almasoud, Fahad N Alkoaik, Mansour N Ibrahim
pmc-11402921.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Evaporative cooling in the kingdom of Saudi Arabia is one of the most important cooling systems used inside greenhouses to obtain an acceptable temperature change in hot, dry climates. It is considered insufficient during very hot summer periods, when temperatures outside the greenhouse reach approximately 48 °C, which affects the efficiency of cooling, and thus, creates stress on the plants, leading to wilting and a decrease in the production rate. The cooling system is developed by making an insulated rectangular tunnel.

pmc-11538879.title: Gamification in the Design of Virtual Patients for Swedish Military Medics to Support Trauma Training: Interaction Analysis and Semistructured Interview Study
pmc-11538879.creator: Natalia Stathakarou, Andrzej A Kononowicz, Erik Mattsson, Klas Karlgren, Tiffany Leung, Naseem Ahmadpour, M Tayyab Chaudhry, Luke Woodham
pmc-11538879.description: BackgroundThis study explores gamification in the design of virtual patients (VPs) to enhance the training of Swedish military medics in trauma care. The challenges related to prehospital trauma care faced on the battlefield require tailored educational tools that support military medics’ education and training.

pmc-11610072.title: Predictors of time to unplanned implanon discontinuation in the first year of application at public hospitals in North Shoa, Central Ethiopia: using acceleration failure time model
pmc-11610072.creator: Befekadu Tesfaye Oyato, Husen Zakir Abasimel, Derara Girma Tufa, Hana Israel Gesisa, Dursa Hussein, Bacha Merga Chuko
pmc-11610072.description: IntroductionContraceptive discontinuation has become a widespread issue on a global basis. Implants, of which Implanon is the most popular, are only the second most widely used form of modern contraceptive in Ethiopia. However, Implanon was discontinued at a rate as high as 23.4% in Ethiopia within the first year of use.

pmc-12559547.title: Multi-omics profiling uncovers paradoxical Epstein-Barr virus involvement in autoimmune liver disease pathogenesis
pmc-12559547.creator: Linyi Zheng, Yuqiang Li, Cenap Güngör, Heming Ge
pmc-12559547.description: Autoimmune liver disease (AILD) is a group of immune-mediated chronic liver injury diseases of unknown etiology. The pathogenesis of AILD is not clear, and it poses a serious threat to human life and health for a long time. Several case reports and observational studies have shown that the Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) is directly associated with AILD.

pmc-12584831.title: Bradykinin-bradykinin 2 receptor and oxidative stress
pmc-12584831.creator: Jun Zhao, Zhuanping Wang, Xuetao Wang, Fangjun Yang, Huirong Xi, Jiantao Wen, Wenjing Zhang, Xiaoming Qiu
pmc-12584831.description: IntroductionBradykinin (BK) and its primary receptor, the bradykinin 2 receptor (B2R), play pivotal roles in regulating oxidative stress. While B2R activation has traditionally been linked to elevated reactive oxygen species (ROS) and pro-apoptotic signalling, growing evidence indicates that, under specific contexts, it also exerts antioxidative and cytoprotective effects, enhancing cell survival, promoting proliferation and attenuating apoptosis.

pmc-12703551.title: Unmasking Hereditary Fructose Intolerance: Turning a Rare Diagnosis Into a Path for Healing
pmc-12703551.creator: Rajat Kumar Shah, Sajjad Ahmed Khan, Bijita Aryal, Aakash Khatiwada, Binita Gurubacharya, Shamin Parajuli
pmc-12703551.description: Early diagnosis of children with hereditary fructose intolerance, which can be achieved by proper history taking, thorough clinical examination, response to diet, and histopathological examination, followed by effective management with a lifelong fructose, sucrose, and sorbitol‐free diet, ensures good prognosis and normal life.

pmc-13215385.title: The effect of group size and laying month on the quality, IgG, and corticosterone levels of goose eggs
pmc-13215385.creator: Lili Dóra Brassó, István Komlósi, Levente Czeglédi, Gabriella Gulyás
pmc-13215385.description: Environmental stress is known to negatively affect poultry health, production, and egg quality. Our study aimed to evaluate the effects of two different group sizes and the laying month on egg quality characteristics as well as the effect of group size on corticosterone and IgG levels in goose eggs.

pmc-13382261.title: Severe Gastrointestinal Graft-versus-Host Disease Following Haploidentical Stem Cell Transplantation Presenting With Passage of a Colonic Cast
pmc-13382261.creator: Faisal Abubaker, Mariam Adnan, Noora Almannai, Noora Butti, Eman Aljufairi
pmc-13382261.description: Gastrointestinal graft-versus-host disease (GI-GVHD) is a life-threatening complication of allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation with increased severity in haploidentical settings. We report a fatal case of severe, steroid-refractory GI-GVHD in a 67-year-old male following haploidentical stem cell transplantation for myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts-2. The patient developed multiorgan complications including refractory cytopenias, severe infections, pleural effusions, and hepatic dysfunction.

pmc-13410335.title: Beyond abstinence: Redefining success in cannabis use disorder treatment
pmc-13410335.creator: Tobias B. Atkin, Frances R. Levin, John Mariani, Christina A. Brezing

pmc-13469797.title: DHX15 as a novel immune-related prognostic biomarker in breast cancer: An integrated bioinformatics analysis with in vitro functional validation
pmc-13469797.creator: Fan Li, Qin Yue, Jing Li
pmc-13469797.description: Breast cancer (BC) is a disease that occurs relatively frequently, and its prognosis and treatment outcomes are not optimal at present. Identifying novel BC biomarkers and therapeutic targets is key. DEAH-box helicase 15 (DHX15) is an RNA helicase that exhibits enhanced activity and is closely associated with tumorigenic potential. Alternative splicing is widely dysregulated in BC.

pmc-13590923.title: Network Pharmacology and Experimental Validation Reveal the Potential Antidepressant‐Like Effects of Chaihu Shugan San Associated With Glutamate Homeostasis
pmc-13590923.creator: Yu Xu, Lian Xia, Keyun Zhou, Chuanxin Liu, Xiaoting Tian, Zongchun Yang
pmc-13590923.description: Chaihu Shugan San (CHSGS) is a traditional Chinese formula widely used in the treatment of depression, but its antidepressant‐like effects remain incompletely understood. This study investigated the effects of CHSGS on stress‐induced behavioral abnormalities with a focus on hippocampal glutamate homeostasis.

pmc-13591951.title: Complete mitogenome and phylogenetic analysis of the tertiary relict shrub Platycrater arguta (Hydrangeaceae)
pmc-13591951.creator: Ke Guo, Zhi-Cheng Zhu, Meng-Ru Liu, Xi Liu, Yong-Hua Zhang
pmc-13591951.description: Platycrater arguta Siebold & Zucc., is a monotypic Hydrangeaceae genus, yet its mitogenomic information remains limited. We assembled its mitogenome from PacBio HiFi reads: 435,757 bp (45.76% GC), containing 66 genes (36 protein-coding, 27 tRNA, 3 rRNA). Complex trans-splicing introns occurred in nad1, nad2 and nad5; codons were strongly AT-biased.
